text: that doesnt make any sense. why do big titty anime models load in nwith huge islands when its all a bunch of triangle soup they are surely not coplanar or whatever the hell
resolution: Part of the UV-confetti diagnosis thread that led to the unfold-chart build (see req_3876, commit a85590308). This message narrowed the root cause: island grouping history (req_3426 buckets vs req_3726 coplanar), the import-vs-studio lane split (TEXCOORD_0 reconstruction vs generation), the 18k-soup-vs-1.8k-quads asymmetry (smooth curvature stays in one axis bucket, hard angles shatter), and the verdict that a UV without unfold is only paint storage — the cube-to-cross test is now the pinned law.
